frontend.name: 前端 ESLint/Prettier/类型检查/构建/契约测试

with.run:
set -euo pipefail
dnf install -y tar xz curl
node_version=24.22.1
curl -fsSLO "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${node_version}/node-v${node_version}-linux-x64.tar.xz"
tar -xJf "node-v${node_version}-linux-x64.tar.xz" -C /opt
export PATH="/opt/node-v${node_version}-linux-x64/bin:$PATH"
node --version
npm install -g pnpm@11.9.0
pnpm --version
pnpm --dir ptmcp-ui install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm --dir ptmcp-ui check
pnpm --dir ptmcp-ui test:contracts
